entries.template: An even number of people, from {searchMinimum} to {searchMaximum}, are divided into two unnamed equal groups. If exactly {target} distinct divisions are possible, how many people are there?

Each of {objectCount} distinct documents is assigned independently to one of an unknown number of labelled folders. The folder count is from {searchMinimum} to {searchMaximum}. If {target} assignments are possible, how many folders are there?

{objectCount} identical balls are distributed among an unknown number of labelled boxes, with empty boxes allowed. The box count is from {searchMinimum} to {searchMaximum}. If {target} distributions are possible, how many boxes are there?
